title: Suspension Pistol Squat (Assisted)
summary: A one-leg squat holding suspension straps for balance and a little help, building toward a full pistol.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.7 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.4 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly adductors total.

setup.text: Hold the handles and stand on one leg with the other straight out in front.
Sit down as low as you can on one leg, pulling on the straps only as needed.

form_cues.cue: Sit down on the working leg
Use the straps only as needed
Use the straps as little as possible.

mistakes.text: Pulling with the arms to stand.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
